data.description:
After the duplicate product ID fix, re-import the Oct 15 Greenleaf sales CSV so the products that were overwritten (e.g. Store 3 / Store 7, product_id 10452) get their correct names and stock levels back.

* Re-run importer for Oct 15 only
* Spot-check 10 products per affected store
* Tell Sarah Kim when the pilot data is clean again
